sources.evidence: Each SVG names the inspected C++ example directory or runnable CuTeDSL Python file. Role branches, schedule selection, shared storage, and architecture-specific memory were inspected in the pinned local checkout.

authoring.goal: Explain the source-selected warp-specialized schedule, handoffs, and SMEM/TMEM partition for each runnable CUTLASS example without implying cycle-accurate timing.
authoring.audience: GPU kernel engineers comparing CUTLASS warp-specialization designs.
reading_order: source-specific design delta and configuration caveats
required_content: name the inspected source path and pinned commit
show role ownership and major waits or handoffs
show exactly three top-level phases: prologue, mainloop, and epilogue
show TMEM usage or explicitly state that TMEM is unavailable or unused
align resource lifetimes and stage reuse to the same three-phase axis
separate code-observed facts from configuration-dependent interpretation
excluded_content: claims copied only from filenames without code inspection
